name: Sertraline
executiveSummary: SSRI. Adult: start **50 mg PO/day** (range **50–200 mg/day**). OCD may need higher doses. Pediatrics (≥6 y OCD; adolescent depression by country): start **25 mg**, then **50 mg**. Do not stop abruptly; suicide ideation risk early on.
indications:
## Indications

- Major depression, OCD, panic, PTSD, social anxiety, PMDD (per label).

## Precautions

- Close monitoring first weeks (suicidal ideation, agitation).
- Serotonin syndrome with MAOIs, triptans, tramadol, other serotonergics.
- Hyponatremia (elderly); bleeding with NSAIDs/anticoagulants.
- Pregnancy/lactation: risk–benefit balance.

> Clinical effect often needs **2–4 weeks**.

adulto.dose: Depression/anxiety: **50 mg PO/day**; titrate weekly to **50–200 mg/day**. Panic: sometimes start **25 mg** × 1 week. Max **200 mg/day**.
adulto.administration: PO morning or night, with or without food; same time.

pediatrico.dose: OCD ≥6 y: **25 mg/day** × 1 week → **50 mg/day**; max 6–12 y **200 mg**; adolescents similar to adult under specialist. Depression: only if locally authorized / psychiatry.

neonatal.dose: Do not start. In utero exposure: possible neonatal adaptation syndrome.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Nausea, diarrhea, insomnia, sexual dysfunction, sweating, tremor; rare: hyponatremia, seizures, serotonin syndrome.

bibliography.citation: FDA. SSRI boxed warning — suicidal thinking in young people.
